title: Implement Wheelwright Handles: model intelligence and telemetry exchange service
description: Build Wheelwright Handles as the product layer for AI model-selection intelligence. Handles combines wheel registration, optional telemetry sharing, delayed public/member reporting, and premium fresher insight into a web service that helps users choose models better and gives the market real operational intelligence about which models perform best for which classes of work. Tracks may be stored through services such as Box.com with free-tier support and paid expansion paths. Free service can be subsidized by telemetry contribution, cached hub access, and delayed insight access, while preserving paid pathways for fresher or deeper analytics.
non_goals: Do not require cohort sharing for local Wheelwright correctness
Do not expose private or fresh user data publicly by default
Do not hardcode a single cloud storage provider as the permanent only option
Do not implement manipulative rankings without provenance and confidence metadata

must_be_sequential: 1. Define Handles as a Wheelwright product line distinct from Octo and Ozi.
2. Define wheel registration, membership, and telemetry-contribution model.
3. Define track ingest and exchange service boundaries, including free-tier storage patterns such as Box.com and a cached hub access model.
4. Define delayed reporting policy for free/member access and premium fresher-data entitlements.
5. Define market-intelligence outputs: model/work-class rankings, confidence metadata, and trend reporting.
6. Define privacy, provenance, and anti-gaming constraints so rankings remain trustworthy.
7. Persist the product architecture and revenue boundaries in this lug before implementation begins.
can_parallelize: Draft membership/storage model and delayed-reporting model in parallel
Draft scoring/provenance model and premium data boundary in parallel

verification_requirements: Verify Handles is framed as operational intelligence and guidance, not raw opaque data vending
Verify telemetry contribution, delayed access, and premium fresher insight are all explicitly separated
Verify Box.com/free storage support is modeled as an integration path rather than a permanent single-vendor lock-in
Verify trust signals such as provenance, confidence, and anti-gaming controls are first-class
Verify the product clearly complements the hub model-routing advisor and cohort-sharing architecture

acceptance_tests.expected: Free/member delayed insight, premium fresher insight, and telemetry contribution model are all explicit
Rankings include provenance/confidence/anti-gaming constraints rather than being hand-wavy scores
Handles is clearly positioned as a Wheelwright product that operationalizes model-choice intelligence

review_questions: Is Handles clearly separated from core local Wheelwright behavior?
Are the free/member/premium data boundaries economically and technically coherent?
Is the telemetry-for-value exchange explicit without making local operation dependent on it?
Is the scoring/ranking design trustworthy enough to become a real market signal?
implementer_review.block_reason: Cluster 1 hub infrastructure (routing table + Octo) must be operational before product/commercial layer can be implemented. website/ directory does not yet exist.

product_model.name: Wheelwright Handles
product_model.positioning: Operational intelligence for AI model selection and workflow routing
product_model.free_member_value: Delayed insight and cached/shared utility for members
product_model.premium_value: Fresher and deeper insight, segmentation, and optimization intelligence
product_model.market_value: Trusted rankings and work-class intelligence that users and vendors care about
product_model.behavioral_exchange: Users can contribute behavioral/taste data and receive delayed or fresher insight, credits, and product influence in return.

storage_exchange_model.principle: Storage/service integrations are hooks for easier telemetry gathering and exchange, not the sole product value.

ranking_trust_model.warning: Vendors may chase the rankings, so trust and manipulation resistance must be designed up front.
ranking_trust_model.goal: Become a respected operational ranking provider for serious AI workflow users.

workflow.handoff_reason: Blocked until Cluster 1 ships. Do not claim.

progress: ✅ Captured Handles as a first-class Wheelwright product line
✅ Captured telemetry-for-value exchange model and delayed free/member insight
✅ Captured Box.com/free storage integration as a hook rather than the whole value proposition
✅ Captured the need for trustworthy rankings that vendors and users will care about

notes: Expanded Handles to include popularity/ranking/community influence surfaces and a credits-for-data exchange model.
blocking_conditions: implementation-hub-model-routing-table-v1 must be accepted (hub owns model routing)
implementation-octo-gardener-dispatch-v1 must be accepted (hub orchestration must exist)
website/ directory and hosting infrastructure must be established before implementation begins
